title: Prepare v0.5.67 after verified v0.5.66 publication
rawUserRequest: 完成现有既定目标以后发布新版本；发布前同步已发布版本的真实公开证据，不能复用已存在或失败保留的版本号，并按完整 Work Item、PR、合并、关闭流程完成。

declaredIntent.summary: 将公开发布的 v0.5.66 证据安全同步为仓库当前的 published projection，并推进不可复用的下一个候选 v0.5.67，确保正式发布从准确且可验证的 candidate metadata 开始。

sources.reason: Published provider Release and immutable tag to be synchronized as repository evidence.
Canonical atomic synchronizer that promotes verified release assets and advances the candidate patch.
Executable validation of reserved tags, stable releases, projections, and candidate sequencing.
Release identity, candidate, source binding, and immutable tag policy.
Exact merged base from which this preparation is performed.

riskAssessment.reason: Release metadata is an adopter-facing identity boundary; a stale or reused tag would invalidate installation authority.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized merge, release, and close; this WI only prepares the evidence-bound next candidate.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Public v0.5.66 release.json and release-digests.json assets are downloaded and their SHA-256 digests are verified before synchronization.

The canonical synchronizer advances release.json, version.json, install.sh, release-state.json, and next-release.json so v0.5.66 is the published projection and v0.5.67 is the sole unpublished candidate.
The candidate does not reuse any immutable reserved tag, all reserved tags have explanatory unavailable evidence, and candidate supply-chain digests match the repository evidence.
Release state consistency, release readiness/distribution preparation, Work Item governance checks, and required project tests pass; no public tag or Release is created by this preparation WI.
guidelines: Use the canonical source-bound projection synchronizer; do not hand-edit release identity or digest fields.
Do not reuse an immutable tag, delete historical release evidence, or claim publication before the provider workflow succeeds.
Keep the preparation limited to release projections and their evidence-bound Work Item records.

intent.problem: origin/main still projects v0.5.65 even though GitHub has a stable immutable v0.5.66 Release, while next-release.json still proposes the already reserved v0.5.66 tag.
constraints: Do not mutate the existing v0.5.66 tag or public Release.
Do not publish from a moving work branch; the later release workflow must use the exact merged main SHA.
Preserve all historical unavailable-tag evidence and keep public release.json distinct from the next candidate projection.
intent.rationale: A canonical projection sync is required before a new release can be prepared; otherwise release preflight would bind the next publication to stale or reused identity facts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The provider has stable v0.5.66 and immutable reserved v0.5.66, while source projections still reference v0.5.65.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The published projection becomes v0.5.66 and the next candidate becomes v0.5.67 without changing the provider release.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the canonical synchronizer with verified provider asset digests, then run release state and distribution checks.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The next candidate equals an immutable reserved tag.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Candidate preparation fails closed or advances past the reserved tag; it never claims the reserved version is publishable.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run candidate sequencing validation against the real provider tag and release lists.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Release assets have a digest or source identity mismatch.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Synchronization makes no partial projection update and reports the mismatch.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the synchronizer's digest-bound CLI validation and its regression tests.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized the release preparation and publication sequence; restricted release projections are updated only through the canonical synchronizer and evidence refresh.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
